Photoreal live-action, London, March 1881, gas from the right, black shadow, 35 mm film grain.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:08. The shot begins from <Picture 3>: a medium shot of Enoch <Subject 1> bare-headed in the heavy black broadcloth frock coat walking up the platform through the steam at a walking pace, the coarse florid face flushed and scowling, the gold watch chain across the waistcoat, the gas lamps at the right. The camera is on the platform at a standing man's eye, three long strides from him, a 35mm lens. The gas lamps come from the RIGHT onto his face. At the first frame Enoch Drebber stands at the CENTRE of the frame from the BOTTOM edge to the TOP third, his head a quarter of the frame height. The camera pans right across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth as the iron columns keep the right third, from 00:00 to 00:03. At 00:03 <Subject 1> walks along the platform to the barrier at a walking pace. At 00:05 his thick hand swings a hand's breadth, and the swing continues to the last frame of the shot. Behind <Subject 1> travellers in dark coats walk along the platform at a walking pace in twos and threes, a porter in a peaked cap pushes a barrow of trunks, from 00:00 to 00:08. <Subject 1>'s mouth is closed from 00:00 to 00:07 while he walks along the platform to the barrier at a walking pace. By 00:08 the camera is panning right through the last frame, and the action continues with it.
